name: cache-warmer
description: Keeps a big session's prompt cache warm while you are away: a few minutes before it would expire, one cheap tool-less request over the cached transcript restarts the clock. Capped by hours, skipped under a context size, and the cost is shown.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request: 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 on some API setups

leadMinutes.title: Ping this many minutes before expiry
leadMinutes.description: How long before the cache would expire the ping goes out

maxHours.title: Stop after this many idle hours
maxHours.description: Pings stop once the session has been idle this long; your next message starts a fresh run

minTokens.title: Only warm a context of at least (tokens)
minTokens.description: Below this the saving is too small to bother
